hypothesis: And <name type="person">Ion</name> of <name type="ethnic">Chios</name>, having gained the tragic crown at <name type="place">Athens</name>, gave a pot of <name type="ethnic">Chian</name> wine to every <name type="ethnic">Athenian</name> citizen.
note: DECISION: the order of tags under the same parent is ignored, because English word order legitimately differs from Greek. With a strict order rule (as in Hashimoto et al.) this would be False.
